title: telemetry (sample batch + state event)
description: Live EVA session messages (F31). Two documents: a telemetry batch (#/$defs/batch, body of POST /sessions/{id}/telemetry: samples in the planner frame, pad-local metres, x east, y north, z up, contracts/bundle/README.md; one sample per second of EVA time) and a state event (#/$defs/state_event, the response of a telemetry post with the commands pending for the simulator, and the SSE payload of GET /sessions/{id}/stream). The root accepts either one. Per-session and per-second limits come from config/backend.yaml (limits.telemetry_*, sessions.*), not from this schema.
x-source: Backend spec §7 (telemetry sample), F31 (state event, commands); D41 (frame)

sample.description: One telemetry sample (spec §7): {t_eva_s, x_m, y_m, z_m, speed_ms, o2_left_L, source}.

x_m.description: east of the pad, m (planner frame)

source.description: unity = the simulator; hud = the web HUD; replay = the session replay tool (WS14 task 5)

batch.description: Body of POST /sessions/{id}/telemetry: samples in increasing t_eva_s.

command.description: A console command for the simulator (POST /sessions/{id}/commands), delivered in the state event of the next telemetry post. Kinds: config/backend.yaml sessions.commands; text length: sessions.message_max_chars.

command_request.description: Body of POST /sessions/{id}/commands (the server assigns id and created_utc).

state_event.description: Server state after the latest sample: field lookups at the position, reference O2 from physio_core, margin and alarm (F31 step 3), plus pending commands.

t_home_min.description: time home from the return field; null off the grid or unreachable

binding.description: the term that sets margin_min (as timeline margin_binding)
